name: aruvi-monorepo
description: npm workspaces root — web/ (Next.js) and packages/shared (client logic shared with the phone app). mobile/ is deliberately NOT a workspace: its React 19 / react-native tree must not be hoisted beside the web's React 18 (expo-doctor found two Reacts, 2026-09-11) — it installs on its own and links packages/shared by path. The Python API is not part of this; see pyproject.toml.
